name: Szikzith
publication: NERDS Restoring Harmony: A Web of Lies
section: T2. Beehive Room and Monster/NPC Statistics
sourceDistinctions: The encounter calls Szikzith an awakened giant wolf spider, but her named stat block prints its own ability array and bite.
The language field prints a dash while the encounter describes bargaining and conversation.
The laid-out states the +3 attack bonus, without changing it to match a derived bonus.
appearanceEvidence: Unnumbered sheet 5 describes a spider with a honey-distended body. The portrait uses the rust-brown color seen on the catalog token.

name: Sled Dog
printing: October 2014 first-print English hardcover with the October 2014 version 1 online supplement
sourceDistinctions: The adventure identifies twelve sled dogs and explicitly uses Wolf stats. The supplement supplies the Medium Beast block.
The generic WotC Wolf is the mechanics base and the depicted subject is a harnessed domesticated dog.
appearanceEvidence: The local publication token shows a black-and-white harnessed northern dog. The adventure describes sled travel and the dogs’ presence at the icy chasm.

name: Giant Spider
publication: Stranger Things: Welcome to the Hellfire Club
printing: October 2025 English digital adventure pack, original-content export
section: Appendix B, Monsters & NPCs, Giant Spider, CR 1. Also Adventurers vs Demogorgon, D5 and S5.
sourceDistinctions: The export provides a complete CR 1 stat block. The paper folio has not been checked.
The contemporary publisher index gives a separate same-name CR 6 Beast, which is outside this catalog scope.
This 2024 rules block uses a Dexterity save for Web and prints its destructive parameters.
appearanceEvidence: The publisher illustration and the adventure’s two nest encounters show a conventional giant spider. The reuse portrait preserves the fangs and eight long legs.
